nom: cocokind Ceramide Barrier Nourishing Daily Serum

avis.texte: I LOVED this serum and had just repurchased a new bottle (larger sized bottle) recently. I opened it and found clear strands coming out from the dropper. These clear strands resembled fiberglass. The strands didn't bend and would just break off into smaller pieces. I never had this issue with my other bottle (standard size bottle). These strands were all throughout the product in general. I would highly recommend checking your products before putting them on your skin as fiberglass can cause irritation! I will be returning this product and also emailing Cocokind regarding the situation. I'm so disappointed.

I have acne prone skin that is very easily irritated. Ive been using this serum daily for a month and a half and have noticed significant improvement. I just ordered my second bottle. It does not break me out and helps retain moisture. I use it every morning after my azelaic acid & at night after my retinol treatments. My skin looks so much better.

Forever a staple in my skincare routine! Definitely feel a difference in my skin when I run out of this product and havent had time to restock. Im on my third or fourth bottle of this and its help my dry acne prone skin so much!

avis.titre: A staple in my nighttime skincare routine
avis.texte: This serum is a staple in my routine every night. It hydrates while ensuring my barrier is supported and protected. It is gentle and lightweight on the skin, as someone with combo to slightly oily skin it does not clog my pores or feel heavy. It layers well with other skincare and under makeup. It delivers results with consistent use.

Its hard to find a serum that provides dewy, milky hydration without being too sticky or heavy! This is so lightweight and so helpful for my extremely dry skin! Winter makes my skin flaky so this is a savior!

I've been through many rounds of medical treated skin problems since I was 19 years old. This serum is PERFECT for phases of a broken skin barrier. If you're confused about the purpose of this serum, it helps to nourish and restore the barrier back to its natural form: healthy. It helps my skin feel calm and hydrated. However, I do recommend getting a separate serum for hydration IF you have chronically dry skin like me. I do not primarily use this for hydration purposes, but I do think this would work great for people who have a normal to slightly dry complexion.

avis.texte: Caused me to have painful acne after using it a couple times. I then retried it and got the same result. Then passed it onto my sister and after her first use it turned her face immediately red with a hot burning sensation.

avis.titre: Caused Burning and Ruined My Progress
avis.texte: I thought because it was advertised as great for sensitive skin that i would give it a try. I am fair skin, have rosacea and am incredibly sensitive to a lot of products. And unfortunately, this is now one of them. I tested it and within seconds, my face thrned bright red/pink and felt like it was melting off. Please be careful if you decide to purchase. I understand everyones skin reacta different, but if you have been struggling to make progress with getting clear skin and deal with something like this, you'd understand why Im so disappointed. It set me back and made all the progress I had made just useless.

This was my holy grail, probably my 8th bottle by now. I took a break trying corex peptide serum which was not as good as this serum so went back to it. After reading other recent bad reviews saying the same thing, had to share my disappointment as well. Cocokind is usually great & affordable but now I'll probably have to spend double on a similar product without the bad reaction. I thought my skin was the issue but my skin reacts fine with my other products so my skin barrier can't be messed up. Loving the corex mask! Def helped while not having a regular moisturizer.

My face and neck have been freaking out lately due to histamine reactions and I've been trying so many different products to try to get my skin to heal. My favorite serum! My skin feels so healthy after using this regularly. Also has helped with the eczema on my cheeks.

For weeks my face has been suffereing due to hives, redness, and dryness needed to get something that protects my skin barrier. I have finally found this amazing product!! It feels silky smooth and hydrating on my face. Cleared up my redness and dryness. Cocokind thank you!!!
Great product! Works well after 3 weeks with a glow and clearness on your face! So much hydration so a few dabs are perfect. Great routine to add! Highly recommend

I was extremely excited to try the Cocokind Ceramide Barrier Serum after seeing that it was approved by the National Eczema Association. Upon application, the serum immediately caused a strong burning sensation on my face. Shortly after, it triggered a painful eczema flare-up, making my skin significantly more irritated and uncomfortable.
This is my most re-stocked item from this brand! Truly nothing else like it, must have always!

avis.titre: What I need when my skin is screaming SOS
avis.texte: Texture & Scent: Light, creamy serum with a silky finish feels instantly soothing going on. No noticeable scent, which is ideal for my sensitive skin. How it works with other products: I layer it after the Chlorophyll Discoloration Serum and before the Electrolyte Water Cream, and it fits seamlessly into both my morning and evening routines. No pilling, no residue just hydration and calm. Results: This has been a game-changer for my compromised skin barrier. Redness is reduced, tightness is gone, and my skin feels noticeably stronger and more hydrated. Its especially helpful after retinoids or exfoliating treatments. Irritation or Sensitivity: As usual with Cocokind, NO irritation. In fact, it calms irritation. This is the product I reach for when my skin needs a reset. Would I repurchase? Absolutely. Its a must-have for barrier supportand proof that you dont need to spend $50+ to get a ceramide serum that actually works.
